publication_reasons: publication requires exact engine order node,bun,deno,zipp with Node as the correctness and ratio baseline
benchmark-affecting environment variables are set (canonical publication requires a clean inherited environment)

cases.description: Stable function-local bindings and a monomorphic leaf call provide the control for closure-heavy dispatch.
Nested factories produce sixteen mutable closures selected at one rotating call site.
Uniform object layouts and one shared property-access path provide the object-shape control.
A shared property site sees sixteen layouts plus shape transitions and dictionary-mode objects.
Integer-only locals provide the control for deliberately unstable local types.
The same local alternates among integer, double, string, object, array, boolean, and null values.
Branch-and-return error signalling provides the control for frequent thrown values.
The hot path frequently throws and catches both primitive and object values.
Rapidly discarded object/array pairs provide the short-lived baseline scenario.
Objects survive several allocation epochs before old cohorts are discarded.
One linear Promise chain provides the short-lived async baseline scenario.
Mutable async closures and repeated Promise.all batches keep the event workload alive.
A host-free React-shaped reconciliation kernel exercises components, state, props, handlers, and patches.
A router, caches, sessions, and varied request shapes run warmup and sustained traffic in one process.
A JavaScript bytecode interpreter stresses branchy dispatch, typed state, and computed helper calls.
A multi-file ESM graph combines live bindings, re-exports, namespace access, and hot imported functions.
The exact nanoid 3.3.17 non-secure ESM source runs behind a deterministic seeded Math.random boundary.
